description: Curated IPC → BNS section mappings for Nyaya-Sahayak Compare feature. Verify against official Gazette / Ministry tables before relying on them for real cases.

mappings.title: Murder
mappings.notes: Punishment for murder is largely aligned; check BNS 103 for exact wording.

mappings.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
mappings.notes: Related provisions also appear nearby in BNS Chapter VI.

mappings.title: Attempt to murder
mappings.notes: Attempt offences are reorganised under BNS.

mappings.title: Rape
mappings.notes: Sexual offences chapter was substantially restructured in BNS.

mappings.title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
mappings.notes: Classic '420' maps to BNS 318.

mappings.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
mappings.notes: Related cruelty provisions continue in BNS 85–86.

mappings.title: Acts endangering sovereignty / sedition-related replacement
mappings.notes: IPC sedition (124A) was replaced; BNS 152 covers related sovereignty/security concerns with different framing.

mappings.title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
mappings.notes: Hit-and-run consequences often involve Motor Vehicles Act + BNS rash/negligent provisions. Always check both.

mappings.title: Causing death by negligence
mappings.notes: Often relevant in road-accident / medical-negligence discussions.

mappings.title: Criminal intimidation
mappings.notes: Intimidation offence renumbered under BNS.

mappings.title: Theft
mappings.notes: Theft chapter renumbered; check BNS 303 for punishment tiers.

mappings.title: Robbery
mappings.notes: Robbery / dacoity cluster was reorganised under BNS.

mappings.title: Dacoity
mappings.notes: Dacoity remains a distinct aggravated property offence in BNS.

mappings.title: Dishonestly receiving stolen property
mappings.notes: Receiving stolen property maps near cheating/property offences in BNS.

mappings.title: Criminal breach of trust
mappings.notes: CBT language is carried forward with new numbering.

mappings.title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
mappings.notes: Confirm exact punishment limb in BNS 316.

mappings.title: Forgery
mappings.notes: Forgery and related document offences were regrouped in BNS.

mappings.title: Forgery for purpose of cheating
mappings.notes: Often discussed with cheating (BNS 318) in fraud cases.

mappings.title: Using as genuine a forged document
mappings.notes: Using forged documents remains a separate charge path.

mappings.title: Defamation
mappings.notes: Defamation continues under BNS with updated numbering.

mappings.title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of a woman
mappings.notes: Sexual harassment / insult-to-modesty cluster was reorganised.

mappings.title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
mappings.notes: Related offences appear in the sexual offences / women-safety chapters of BNS.

mappings.title: Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions
mappings.notes: Offences against public justice / public servants were renumbered.

mappings.title: False evidence / related false-statement offences
mappings.notes: Confirm exact limb for giving/ fabricating false evidence in BNS.

mappings.title: Causing disappearance of evidence / giving false information
mappings.notes: Evidence-tampering related offences continue under BNS public-justice chapters.

mappings.title: Criminal conspiracy
mappings.notes: Conspiracy concepts continue; always check the substantive offence too.

mappings.title: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention
mappings.notes: Common intention principle is retained in BNS general explanations.

mappings.title: Abetment of a thing
mappings.notes: Abetment definitions and punishments were reorganised early in BNS.

mappings.title: Unlawful assembly
mappings.notes: Public order offences including unlawful assembly / rioting were renumbered.

mappings.title: Rioting
mappings.notes: Related to unlawful assembly provisions in BNS.

mappings.title: Hurt

mappings.title: Grievous hurt (definition / related)
mappings.notes: Verify exact definition and punishment limbs in current BNS text.

mappings.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
mappings.notes: Common charge in assault cases; confirm BNS limb.

mappings.title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt
mappings.notes: Often paired with weapon / dangerous means enhancements nearby.

mappings.title: Wrongful restraint

mappings.title: Wrongful confinement

mappings.title: Criminal intimidation (definition / related)

mappings.title: False information to public servant
